title: Jovial Earthy Malaysian Linguine Pasta Bake
description: A flavorful and comforting Malaysian dish featuring linguine pasta, en-croute, and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients, perfect for a lazy Sunday. This recipe is cooked to perfection in an iron-teppan vessel.
instructions: Preheat the iron-teppan vessel to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the linguine pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a separate pan, saute the mushrooms and spinach in olive oil until the mushrooms are tender.
Add the curry powder to the pan and stir for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pasta, mushroom mixture, and cubed tofu.
Pour the coconut milk over the pasta mixture and stir until well combined.
Roll out the en-croute pastry and place it over the iron-teppan vessel.
Fill the pastry with the pasta mixture and brush the edges with olive oil.
Bake the pasta bake for 25 minutes or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove from heat and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
